summary: Iteration 4 testing of (1) recurring event exceptions endpoints, (2) is_owner permission gating on PUT /api/family/info, (3) CheckoutMode shopping flow. Backend: 13/14 pass (new exception endpoints all pass; owner permission gating works perfectly with mongosh-toggle of is_owner; one assertion FAILED revealing a real bug — legacy parents lack is_owner field in /api/family/members because raw mongo docs are returned). Frontend: app loads, FamilyCard shows 'Owner' badge + edit pencil for owner, CheckoutMode opens with per-store tabs, progress bar, and Finish button. CRITICAL frontend regression discovered: WeekendCard.jsx crashes with ReferenceError: Repeat is not defined whenever a recurring event is rendered (DayBlock uses <Repeat /> but the file only imports Sparkles from lucide-react).

minor.issue: Returns raw Mongo docs without coercing through User pydantic model. Legacy parent docs created before is_owner was added (e.g. test-user-solo-1776808359819) are returned WITHOUT the is_owner key, breaking the frontend Owner-badge gating contract. Recommend: either backfill via one-time mongo update {is_owner: {$ifNull:["$is_owner", true]}} OR project with $ifNull OR serialize each doc through User(**doc).model_dump().

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: Repeat is not defined at line 72. <Repeat size={11} /> is rendered when an event has recurring !== 'none', but the file imports only Sparkles from lucide-react (line 2). Crashes the weekend card and breaks the Calendar UI flow whenever any recurring event falls in the next/current weekend window. Reproduced by POST /api/events with recurring='daily' then refreshing the dashboard. Fix: change line 2 to `import { Sparkles, Repeat } from 'lucide-react';`

Console warning: `DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users` and `Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}`. The visible header uses a plain <div>, not <DialogTitle>. Wrap the 'Shopping Mode' heading with DialogTitle (and add a DialogDescription or VisuallyHidden one) to satisfy Radix accessibility.

action_items: FIX (critical): Add `Repeat` to the lucide-react import in /app/frontend/src/components/WeekendCard.jsx line 2 — the missing import crashes DayBlock whenever a recurring event hits the weekend window and prevents the user from interacting with the Calendar/event-action chooser.

FIX (medium): Make GET /api/family/members guarantee the is_owner field exists (backfill legacy docs OR serialize through User model OR project with $ifNull) so the Owner badge / non-owner gating works consistently for previously-created parents.
FIX (low): Replace plain header div in CheckoutMode with shadcn DialogTitle (+ DialogDescription/VisuallyHidden) to satisfy Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: backfill any legacy users.is_owner via `db.users.updateMany({is_owner:{$exists:false}}, {$set:{is_owner:true}})` (safest default since legacy users were the original family creators).
critical_code_review_comments: Event.exceptions field uses $addToSet on POST /api/events/{id}/exceptions — verified idempotent and correctly returns updated event with refreshed exceptions array. Defaults to [] when absent.

DELETE /api/events/{id}/exceptions/{date} uses $pull and refetches doc — works, but never validates the event belongs to the user's family before the find_one (it does, via family_id filter). However if the event does not exist at all, the function still returns 404 only after the 2nd find_one — minor extra DB call. OK.
PUT /api/family/info correctly enforces is_owner check at line 344. 403 message text matches spec.
auth/session correctly sets is_owner=False when joined via valid invite_token and True for fresh signups. family/join correctly demotes joiner to is_owner=False.

FRONTEND: CalendarCard.openEdit + performAction implements the single/series chooser correctly: 'single' edit clones event with recurring='none' then $addToSet exception on original; 'single' delete just adds exception; 'series' edit/delete hits PUT/DELETE. Logic is sound.

FRONTEND BUG: WeekendCard.jsx is missing Repeat in its lucide-react import — a regression introduced when iteration-3 added the recurring badge to DayBlock. This crash blocks the calendar interaction. HIGH priority.

success_rate.frontend: Manual smoke - CheckoutMode opens & renders correctly; FamilyCard owner badge + edit-pencil visible for owner; HIGH-severity recurring-event crash in WeekendCard blocks the action-chooser flow

test_credentials: Reused PRIMARY token from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (test_session_1776655943013, family-1776655943013). Owner-permission tests toggle is_owner directly via pymongo and restore=True after each test (autouse fixture).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-seed a recurring event (TEST_Recurring Exception Test) and clean it up. Frontend smoke seeded TEST_Bread/TEST_Milk/TEST_Apples shopping items + a TEST_RecurringDaily event (cleaned up where possible; manual cleanup may be needed if WeekendCard crash blocked teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration4.py is the primary regression for iteration-4 features (exceptions + is_owner gating). The TestOwnerPermissions class uses a pymongo fixture to flip is_owner; ensure MONGO_URL+DB_NAME are exported in shell (only present in /app/backend/.env). The is_owner gap on legacy parents in /api/family/members is a real bug — once main agent backfills, the failing test will pass. The HIGH WeekendCard crash MUST be fixed before recurring-event UI flows can be e2e-validated.

weekend_card_crash.symptom: PAGEERROR: Repeat is not defined in <DayBlock>
weekend_card_crash.root_cause: WeekendCard.jsx imports only `{ Sparkles }` from lucide-react but uses `<Repeat />` at line 72 inside DayBlock
weekend_card_crash.reproduction: POST /api/events with recurring='daily' (any date in current/next weekend) -> reload dashboard -> DayBlock throws
weekend_card_crash.fix: Add Repeat to the lucide-react import statement in WeekendCard.jsx

members_missing_is_owner.symptom: Some parents in /api/family/members lack is_owner key
members_missing_is_owner.root_cause: Endpoint returns Mongo docs raw via .find().to_list(); legacy users created before iter-4 don't have is_owner persisted
members_missing_is_owner.fix: Backfill via mongo updateMany OR coerce via User(**doc).model_dump()
